short_quotes: The Japan Oceanographic Data Center (JODC) operates the RDMDB.
contents of data are not edited
GTS_primary_evidence.assessment: The manual assigns RDMDB operation to JODC and describes classifying transferred reports by type and combining each reception-month into a file. This supplies a specific compilation-function lead beyond receipt or hosting.
GTS_primary_evidence.limits: The passage does not individually credit the five global archive products. Its retrieval section names a regional area and its BATHY example is regional. The five global links come from the separate catalogue. Institutional compilation attribution is therefore an inference requiring independent role review, not an approved creator byline. No QC performance, original-observation creation, sole authorship or immutable 2005 web snapshot is established.

GTS_primary_evidence.short_quote: Month which data had received by JMA
GTS_primary_evidence.assessment: Exact global product labels link to bathyG, buoyG, shipG, tesacG and trackobG monthly filenames. The catalogue assigns receipt to JMA; it does not name JMA as creator of these observations. No example filename establishes historical coverage.

GTS_primary_evidence.locator: GTS Reports lines11-22; Decoded Data lines23-35; Observations by JMA Research Vessels lines41-46
GTS_primary_evidence.assessment: Official index separates five regional/global GTS report classes from derived decoded products, GTSPP and observations made by JMA vessels. BATHY/TESAC source titles fit the report classes; moving creator credit from the derived products would cross those product boundaries.

GTS_primary_evidence.locator: About Usage of the Data, parsed line17
GTS_primary_evidence.short_quote: please acknowledge data sources as "NEAR-GOOS RRTDB"
GTS_primary_evidence.assessment: Explicit current data-source acknowledgement is useful attribution context but does not identify a historical creator/compiler for the two regional GTS collections. Current registration/licensing statements are not substituted for source constraints.

JMA operates RRTDB; its contents separately include GTS-received data, participating-institute contributions and JMA products. Data transfer to JODC after 30 days does not establish observer authorship.
JODC operates RDMDB and receives RRTDB data after 30 days; this supports the workflow linking the technical manual and catalogue, but operator status alone is not creator proof.
